最小、最大及常用线径，注明单位；单丝或并行丝数。不同规格分别列出，并与第 4 项: Minimum, maximum and typical diameters with units; single or parallel wire count. List specifications separately and match each to the speed and output in item 4.

同时说明班次、正常生产、启停、换规格、换盘及断线停机情况；已有线速或产量其中一项: Describe shifts, normal running, start/stop, specification and reel changes, and wire-break downtime. Provide either existing speed or output if only one is known.
